adapters.effectClock: Attachment delay follows actor-state wall time; an attached EffectSet runs independently in wall seconds. Animation-speed ownership remains unmeasured.
adapters.scale: Bone/offset positions and effect geometry use NPC UNIT_SCALE and .28. Emitter size and instance visual scale affect volumes; DirSpeed remains source world speed.
adapters.child: On contact a replacement projectile creates its contact child once and terminates. A same-name death child is suppressed on that contact; ordinary expiry creates the death child. Native ordering remains unmeasured.
adapters.lockOn: Ent ball initially aims at the current hostile target, turns at CURVE_SPEED radians/second until TIME_UNLOCK_FROM_START, then keeps its final direction. Native angular units/range defaults remain unmeasured.
adapters.interruptedBinding: After an attached set outlives an interrupted state, Hurt/Knockdown/GettingUp use the same front/default source reaction selection as the body rules, with their own skeleton-point tracks. The hit-pause-aware pose clock is clamped to the original motion end. Existing generic reaction lifetimes are unchanged. Airborne/dead or legacy unbound reactions retain the documented wait-track fallback.
adapters.curves: Chronological source events; an instant Size overrides current fade value and the remaining fade retargets to its original end. Duplicate sample times preserve jumps without pre-echo.
adapters.collision: Original static Normal helper candidates, source Size, emitter size and random Y rotation; same explicit 19.6px hero depth slab. Native sphere-constructor parity remains unmeasured.

clockPolicy.state: Preserve original SOUND_PLAY time. Candidate state time divides by ANIM_SPEED, matching existing player-sound presentation convention. NPC native sound clock ownership is not independently established; unscaled alternative is retained.
clockPolicy.effect: Mage ball SOUND0 is .01 into the independent effect lifetime used by the existing candidate runner. Under its .24 attachment + .20 emission delay, nominal cast time is .45.

npcSoundRules.eventPolicy: Resource deduplication only. Keep each original event, including repeated same-file cues at different times and Ent two-file simultaneous .25-layer. No synthesized replacements, no generic hit/hurt changes.
npcSoundRules.scope: Static source reachability and source-audio matching only. No Unity/audio audition, original NPC voices completion, camera completion, runtime timer implementation or admission is claimed.

semantics.cooldownInitial: Explicit INITIALIZE_STATE_ELAPSED_TIME; missing0 proved by original getter fallback and instance copy.
semantics.cooldownAdvance: Definition cooldown>0: elapsed+=outer delta after state request processing, including old-positive NPC STOP; no clamp.
semantics.request: Ordered elapsed>=cooldown, including equality; accepted request clears target elapsed and queues state. TRUE is unused by final NPC request method.
semantics.timer1: Constructor0/previous0/enabled1. Advance only on ordinary non-stopped actor frame using actor delta. Independent of state animation and state cooldown.
semantics.callbackOrder: Host; HP/maxHP; nearest-player distance; exactly one integer roll1..100; distance<=500; timer1>1; roll/HP branch; reset timer1 unconditionally after those distance/time gates.
